title: Supplier Quality Audits: Fastener Tensile Strength Non-Conformance
description: Intermediate technical English module analyzing supplier quality audits: fastener tensile strength non-conformance.
learning_objectives: Master professional Reported Speech in Quality Audits in automotive engineering
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in supplier quality audits: fastener tensile strength non-conformance
Demonstrate precision in technical and regulatory documentation

questions.prompt: All backbone tube structural mounting fasteners _____ to 450 Nm according to Tatra workshop manual TM-815.

explanations.correct: Passive construction with modal: 'must be torqued'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' takes bare infinitive.
explanations.wrong_C: 'must torque' is active voice; fasteners do not torque themselves.
explanations.wrong_D: 'are must' is completely ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: SOP instructions require passive voice with modals: 'must be torqued' (musí být dotaženy). Avoid active voice for inanimate parts.
